findings.documented: Documentation specifies user authentication at POST /v1/auth/login.
findings.actual: POST /v1/auth/login returns HTTP 404 Not Found. Real authentication endpoint is at POST /auth/login.
findings.how_found: Tested both path variations; POST /v1/auth/login returned 404, whereas POST /auth/login succeeded returning access_token and refresh_token.
findings.impact: API clients attempting to authenticate using the documented path will fail.

findings.documented: Documentation details GET /v1/favourites, POST /v1/favourites, and DELETE /v1/favourites/{id} for managing user saved properties.
findings.actual: All /v1/favourites endpoints return HTTP 404 Not Found.
findings.how_found: Issued GET, POST, and DELETE requests to /v1/favourites with valid Bearer token and X-API-Key header; server responded with 404.
findings.impact: Favourites functionality cannot be built using documented path.

findings.documented: Endpoint /v1/saved is not mentioned anywhere in API_REFERENCE.md.
findings.actual: GET /v1/saved returns user saved listings (200 OK), POST /v1/saved saves a listing (201 Created), and DELETE /v1/saved/{id} removes a saved listing (200 OK).
findings.how_found: Automated endpoint discovery scan tested candidate routes; /v1/saved responded with full CRUD for user saved listings.
findings.impact: Applications must use /v1/saved instead of documented /v1/favourites to persist saved listings backend.

findings.actual: Returns HTTP 404 Not Found for all listing IDs.
findings.how_found: Queried GET /v1/listings/MAG-1002627/similar with valid token; received 404.
findings.impact: Similar listings feature cannot be populated via backend API.
Analytics and insights must be computed client-side from raw datasets.

findings.documented: Documentation states carpet_area is reported in square feet (sq.ft) across all listing records.
findings.actual: Listings sourced from website == 'magichomes' report carpet_area in square meters (sq.m) (e.g. 75 sq.m for a 2BHK flat), whereas other websites report in sq.ft.
findings.how_found: Inspected carpet_area distributions; magichomes values ranged 45-180 (sq.m), while other websites ranged 400-2500 (sq.ft).
findings.impact: Price per sqft calculations and UI display for magichomes listings will be distorted by 10.76x unless converted.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max fields in /v1/projects are documented to be in raw INR.
findings.actual: price_min and price_max in /v1/projects are expressed in Lakhs INR (e.g. 99.8 = 99.8 Lakhs INR = ₹9,980,000).
findings.how_found: Compared project price_min/price_max (37.0 - 99.8) against individual listing prices in those projects (4,080,000 - 14,750,000 INR).
findings.impact: UI displaying project prices without adjusting for Lakhs will show ₹99.8 instead of ₹99.8 Lakhs.

findings.documented: Documented pagination parameters are page & limit with default 20 and max 100.
findings.actual: API uses offset & limit (not page). Max limit accepted is 50. Total count metadata (4535) differs from retrievable count (4700).
findings.how_found: Tested limit=100 (server returned limit: 50); paged with offset up to 4650 until has_more: false.
findings.impact: Page-based pagination fails; limit > 50 is capped by server.

findings.documented: All listing records contain valid property dimensions, floor numbers, and coordinates.
findings.actual: 214 listing records contain physically impossible data corruption (floor > total_floors, total_floors <= 0, carpet_area > super_built_up_area, bedroom <= 0, or swapped lat/lon).
findings.how_found: Validated physical constraints programmatically across all 4,700 listing records.
findings.impact: Unfiltered metrics (e.g., average price/sqft) will be corrupted by impossible records.

findings.documented: All listings represent genuine property sale offerings.
findings.actual: 16 listings contain fake/clickbait pricing (negative prices or monthly rent listed as sale price) to capture lead enquiries.
findings.how_found: Filtered complete dataset for price anomalies (price < 100,000 INR).
findings.impact: Users see clickbait/negative prices unless filtered.

findings.documented: Each project's total_listings field matches active listings linked to that project in /v1/listings.
findings.actual: 392 out of 520 projects report a total_listings count inconsistent with actual listings linked to project_id in listings dataset.
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by project_id and compared actual counts against project total_listings.
findings.impact: Project counters in UI show inaccurate property availability.
